privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Perdomo Real Estate collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.body:
1. Controller

Perdomo Real Estate is responsible for the personal data you provide through this website.

2. Data we collect

Name, email, phone/WhatsApp, project of interest, budget and the message you send through our forms, plus browsing data when you accept analytics cookies.

3. Purpose

To answer your requests, send you property information, schedule visits and improve our services.

4. Legal basis

Your consent when submitting a form and our legitimate interest in handling your request.

5. Retention

We keep your data while a business relationship exists or until you ask us to delete it.

6. Your rights

You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to our contact email.

7. Providers

We use hosting, database and email providers that process data on our behalf with appropriate safeguards.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies the Perdomo Real Estate website uses and how to manage them.
cookies.body:
What are cookies?

Small files stored in your browser to remember information about your visit.

Cookies we use

  • Technical (necessary): remember your language, currency, favorites and consent choices. Stored locally on your device.
  • Analytics (optional): Google Tag Manager / Google Analytics, only if you accept, to measure site usage.

How to manage them

You can change your choice at any time via the “Cookie preferences” link in the footer, or delete cookies in your browser settings.

Prices, availability, areas, floor plans, images, renders and amenities are for reference only and may change without notice. Always confirm current information with an advisor.

Renders and images

Images and renders may be illustrative and not represent the final product.

Calculators

Payment plan, mortgage and rental-return calculator results are illustrative estimates. They are not financial advice, a credit offer or a guarantee of returns.
